description.en: This ontology represents the European catalog of high-risk medical devices, including manufacturers, incidents, and corrective actions.

comments.en: Ontology for the European catalog of medical devices (MDR/IVDR).

abstract.value: Comprehensive semantic model for the European catalog of medical devices under the MDR and IVDR regulations.

comment.en: An advisory notice issued by a manufacturer to provide information on the safe use for a medical device.
